corrections: Three load-bearing items were wrong in the debate and all cut toward the value case, not against it. (0) BUSINESS EPS: sop_bull/sop_bear capitalize 'business EPS ~EUR 6.0-6.4'; the primary FY-25 release reports business EPS EUR 7.83 (+15.0% CER / +10.0% reported). EUR 6.40 is STATUTORY EPS, mislabeled as 'business EPS' on both sides. This breaks the bear's de-rate floor: at the true EUR 7.83 even the bear's punitive 11x gives ~EUR 86 (above the EUR 75 price), so the EUR 66 'conservative floor' does not exist and the stock is cheap on hostile assumptions. (1) NET DEBT: the SoP overlay (bull and bear) subtracts net debt of EUR 14.48B, flagged as a 'LIVE CORRECTION' from the stale EUR 11B. The primary filings refute the 14.48B: Sanofi reported net debt of EUR 11,008M at 2025-12-31 and EUR 12,900M at 2026-03-31 (Q1-26 release, 2026-04-23). Actual net debt is ~EUR 1.6B LOWER than the figure baked into both SoPs; the EUR 14.48B appears to be a screener artifact (gross/IFRS-16-inclusive or mis-dated). Correcting it lifts both SoP-bull (~EUR 100-102) and SoP-bear (~EUR 72-74) by ~EUR 1.3-1.5/sh. The bear's 'leverage climbing to 14.48B as Opella cash drained into Blueprint' is directionally true (11.0->12.9B) but overstated by ~EUR 1.6B. (2) 2027 REGENERON STEP: the bear casts this as an air-pocket that 'could re-anchor lower.' Primary disclosure bounds it: Dupixent development-balance reimbursement runs off by ~Q2-2026 with impacts to Q2-2027; the BOI drag is ~EUR 400M (2026) and ~EUR 700M (2027), but management discloses BOI still GROWS in both margin and absolute terms through the step. It is a ~1-2pt growth drag, not an earnings cliff; the CFO's 'profitable growth each year' is backed by disclosed math. (3) MFN/TARIFF TAIL: the debate treated US pricing/MFN as un-modelable ('nobody knows'). As of mid-2026 this is now CONTRACTED, not open: Sanofi signed an MFN pricing agreement (one of 14 manufacturers) with avg ~61% cuts on diabetes/CV/neuro/cancer medicines, plus a 3-year Section 232 tariff delay. The cuts hit the legacy low-growth US book, NOT Dupixent (immunology) or vaccines, so the growth engine is shielded; the worst un-modeled tail is now largely known and bounded. Net effect of corrections: the value case is slightly STRONGER than the debate modeled (lower debt, the feared MFN headline resolved, 2027 bounded). Tolebrutinib CRL (2025-12-24) and Dupixent FY-25 EUR 15.714B +25.2% both verify against primary sources, so the no-live-catalyst read stands.
evidence: Sanofi FY-2025 results (Paris, 2026-01-29): FY net sales EUR 43.63B, +9.9% CER; Dupixent EUR 15.714B, +25.2%; net debt EUR 11,008M at 2025-12-31 (vs the debate's asserted EUR 14.48B). Source: sanofi.com press release 2026-01-29-06-30-00-3228191 / SEC 6-K pressreleaseq42025english.

Sanofi Q1-2026 results (Paris, 2026-04-23): net sales EUR 10.5B, +13.6% CER; net debt EUR 12,900M at 2026-03-31 (up from EUR 11,008M at 2025-12-31); Dupixent ~EUR 4.2B +30.8%; vaccines EUR 1.3B +2.1%. Source: sanofi.com press release 2026-04-23-05-30-00-3279572 / SEC 6-K pressreleaseq12026english.
